must_not_flag.why: Posted: [logic-inversion] Inherited ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN still reaches the child — In device mode the child still receives ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from the operator's shell. claudeInheritedModelVars is the drop list, and claudeChildEnv skips only names in it; the new entry is added unconditionally, so a shell export survives into the child and pins the session to a fixed credential, defeating the apiKeyHelper refresh the same change adds. The comment on line 270 says it must not reach the child from any source. Refuted: Claims ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is not dropped, while quoting line 281 that adds it to the drop list and line 311 that skips drop[name]. Evidence refutes the claim.
